newsitem.title: USA: Aviva plan seeks to buy $5 mln US property.
newsitem.headline: Aviva plan seeks to buy $5 mln US property.

text.p: Aviva Petroleum Inc said Thursday it hired Merrick Capital Corp as its financial adviser to assist with its restructuring plan.
This plan includes acquiring $5 million of U.S. oil and gas properties for 10 million shares of Aviva capital stock.

It also includes procuring $12 million to $15 million in mezzanine financing to fund exploitation of its Breton Sound and other prospects, and negotiating a $25 million oil and gas reserve based credit facility.

The company said Jeffrey Rawson, president of Merrick, will, on approval of the restructuring plan, own 50 percent of the shares issued in exchange for such properties, and have voting power over the remaining 50 percent of the shares issued.
The company reported a loss per share for the second quarter of $0.37 compared to a loss of $0.00.
The company said write-downs for oil and gas properties were the major factor contributing to its loss.
